# FireOTA

> Over-the-air updates for React Native, Expo and Flutter apps: publish JavaScript bundles, Dart code patches (Android) and asset/config updates without a store release, with signing, staged rollouts and automatic rollback.

## Set up FireOTA with an AI coding agent

- [FireOTA setup skill](https://fireota.creoai.in/skills/fireota/SKILL.md): step-by-step instructions an agent follows to add FireOTA to a React Native, Expo or Flutter project, publish an update and wire CI.

## EAS Update parity

- Drop-in commands: `fireota update` (`--branch` alias for `--channel`, `--platform all|android|ios`, `--rollout-percentage`, `--auto`).
- Full lifecycle management: `fireota update:list|view|republish|rollback|edit|pause|resume|delete` and `fireota channel:list|create|view|rollout`.
- [Coming from EAS Update](https://fireota.creoai.in/docs/coming-from-eas): command and SDK API mapping from EAS to FireOTA.
